I was changing lanes on the highway in Conroe, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling as I moved over, when a
vehicle in the next lane came alongside me and sideswiped the passenger side of my car. The impact pushed me
toward the median and I heard the girnding of metal along my door before I could fully stop. I hit my head against the
window frame and felt dazed for several minutes afterward. I was taken to a clinic that evening, where I was
diagnosed with a concussion and advised to rest. I have given the same account of what happened to the officer at
the scene, to the medical staff, and to my insurer, and I am the named driver on this policy. I am submitting this
statement so my claim can be reviewed.
